title: Preconditioning of a hybridizable discontinuous Galerkin method for the coupled Stokes--Darcy system
summary: We propose parameter-robust preconditioners for the statically condensed linear system arising from a hybridizable discontinuous Galerkin discretization of the coupled Stokes--Darcy system. The design strategy relies on first applying the operator-preconditioning framework [Numer. Linear Algebra Appl., 18(1):1--40, 2011] to construct a preconditioner for the non-condensed discretization. This is done by proving uniform well-posedness of the scheme.
